ModWickling.name: Wickling
ModWickling.attack: Flare Bite: a hop-lunge bite that may burn
passive: Touch fire to flare your tail up
A flared bite hits harder and always burns

ModTallowGrub.name: Tallow Grub
ModTallowGrub.attack: Wax Spit: a glob that skids and pools, and slows
ModTallowGrub.special: Melt: glide as a puddle (can't be hit), then rise
passive: Melt, glide your puddle under him, then rise
Fire on your puddle burns you out

ModAshMoth.name: Ash Moth
ModAshMoth.attack: Ash Puff: a drifting ash cloud that may daze
ModAshMoth.special: Flame Dive: dive ahead, bending toward fire
passive: Near fire you fly faster
Your death leaves a pyre that cools to wax

ModWaxenKnight.name: Waxen Knight
ModWaxenKnight.attack: Three cuts, and the overhead spills wax
ModWaxenKnight.special: Seal: wax over yourself, then crack off as a ring
passive: Seal throws your flames out as a ring
Burning: cuts burn, but you take more harm

ModChandler.name: Chandler
ModChandler.attack: Molten Glob: lands as a burning pool
ModChandler.special: Pour: a line of unlit wax ahead
passive: Pour a line, wait, then shoot it: it all goes up
The flame runs down the line to him

ModVhWickworm.name: Wickworm
ModVhWickworm.special: Drip Road: slither fast, laying wax
passive: Swim in wax unseen. Only your candles show
Lit wax burns you out. Death leaves a pyre
ModVhWickworm.vault: A long grub with five candles down its back. It swims through wax

ModVhTallowSow.name: Tallow Sow
ModVhTallowSow.attack: Fat Spray: three drops of hot fat that may slow
ModVhTallowSow.special: Lay three wax eggs: soon each spits at the hero
passive: Wallow in wax: his shots glance off your coat
Fire melts the coat. Unlit wax heals you
ModVhTallowSow.vault: Swollen with rendered fat and eggs. Wax makes her slippery

ModMothMatron.name: Moth Matron
ModMothMatron.attack: Ember Rake: leaves an ash puff that may daze
ModMothMatron.special: Moth Lamp: let loose three ember moths
passive: Your moths hunt a burning hero. Else they drift
Drifting moths light any wax they touch

ModCandelabra.name: Candelabra
ModCandelabra.attack: Five Flames: a fan of five candle flames
ModCandelabra.special: Vigil: plant and light the wax near you
passive: Your flames fork in two when they cross wax
Your death leaves a pyre that cools to wax

ModTallowColossus.name: Tallow Colossus
ModTallowColossus.special: Topple: rear up and fall flat on him
passive: Soak up wax to grow. Fire melts your layers off
Each layer: harder fists and a longer Topple

ModVhPyreWarden.name: Pyre Warden
ModVhPyreWarden.attack: Censer Smash: an ember ring that lights wax
ModVhPyreWarden.special: Stoke: the fire near him spreads in three rings
passive: Pyres near you never cool
No fire near? Stoke lights a pyre at your feet
ModVhPyreWarden.vault: It keeps the Saint's pyres. Near it the dead never stop burning

ModVhRenderer.name: Tallow Renderer
ModVhRenderer.attack: Ladle Fling: boiling tallow that may slow
ModVhRenderer.special: Boil Over: a wave of tallow rolls ahead
passive: Tip the pot and ride the wave in
Riding, you can't be knocked back
ModVhRenderer.vault: It boils down what the candles leave, and rides the boil

ModVhWickHag.name: Wick Hag
ModVhWickHag.attack: Hex Flame: a flicked flame that lights wax
ModVhWickHag.special: Poppet: set down a wax poppet of the hero
passive: Burn his poppet and he feels it
Hex flames go for the poppet while he keeps away
ModVhWickHag.vault: She sells candles to the dead, and poppets of the living

ModVhCandleWyrm.name: Candle Wyrm
ModVhCandleWyrm.attack: Rear Strike: strike down just ahead
ModVhCandleWyrm.special: Wick Coil: race a ring of fire round the hero
passive: Coil round him. The closed ring tightens
You swim in wax like the Wickworm
ModVhCandleWyrm.vault: The worm reared up for good. Its mane burns blue at the root

ModVhFuseScorpion.name: Fuse Scorpion
ModVhFuseScorpion.special: Light the Fuse: a spark runs his footsteps
passive: Your fuse follows his footsteps. Wax speeds it up
The spark bursts on him, or burns out
ModVhFuseScorpion.vault: Ash-grey plates on old beeswax. Its tail is a fuse, always lit

ModVhBroodMother.name: Grub Mother
ModVhBroodMother.attack: Head Slam: leaves a wax pool
ModVhBroodMother.special: Brood Spit: three grublings land by the hero
passive: Grubs that crawl through fire burst into flame
Dying lets three grublings loose
ModVhBroodMother.vault: She carries her clutch on her back. The grublings hatch hungry

ModVhPyreTick.name: Pyre Tick
ModVhPyreTick.attack: Barbed Bite: gives the hero a fever
ModVhPyreTick.special: Ember Spray: five drops of burning blood
passive: Your bite gives him fever: wax he steps on lights
Your death leaves a pyre that cools to wax
ModVhPyreTick.vault: It drank from a pyre until it cracked. The fire still shows through

ModVhAshSeraph.name: Ashen Seraph
ModVhAshSeraph.attack: Lance Thrust: a long cinder lance
ModVhAshSeraph.special: Ash to Ash: fires near you go out as ash clouds
passive: Beat fires out: each becomes a dazing ash cloud
The clouds drift after him

ModLanternWraith.name: Lantern Wraith
ModLanternWraith.attack: Soul Orb: an orb that bursts where it stops
ModLanternWraith.special: Take the Light: a cone that steals his soul flame
passive: Steal his soul flame: he hits softer
Your orbs hit harder while you hold it

ModVhChandelier.name: Grand Chandelier
ModVhChandelier.special: Drip and Flare: drip a ring of wax, then light it
passive: High on your chain, blades can't reach you
You bob low, then high, in turn

ModVhReliquary.name: Votive Reliquary
ModVhReliquary.attack: Votive Fan: three flames that light wax
ModVhReliquary.special: Anoint: holy oil on every kin near you
passive: Anoint your kin: their next two hits burn
Anointed, your own fan throws five flames
ModVhReliquary.vault: A shrine on roots with a weeping skull. Its oil sets kin alight
